title: Polynomial advice simulation of circuit families
statement: Let $L$ be a language of finite binary words, and let $a,k\in\mathbb N$. If $L$ has a family of Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two whose circuit on inputs of length $n$ has size at most $a(n+1)^k$, then there are natural numbers $c,d$ such that $L$ is decidable by a finite Turing machine with advice of length $n^d$ at each input length $n$ and running time at most a constant multiple of $n^c+1$.
hypotheses_covered: L is a language of binary words
L has fan-in-two circuit size at most a(n+1)^k at every input length
